statements.subject: user
statements.description: The user who CLOSEs may continue to RECEIVE until the TCP receiver is told that the remote peer has CLOSED also.
actions: allow user to continue issuing RECEIVE until remote peer CLOSE is indicated

statements.subject: user
statements.description: Users must keep reading connections they close for sending until the TCP implementation indicates there is no more data.
actions: continue issuing RECEIVE until TCP implementation signals no more data available

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: A TCP connection may terminate in two ways: (1) the normal TCP close sequence using a FIN handshake (Figure 12), and (2) an "abort" in which one or more RST segments are sent and the connection state is immediately discarded.
statements.trigger: FIN handshake completion or RST sent
actions: normal close: complete FIN handshake sequence
abort: send one or more RST segments and immediately discard connection state

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If the local TCP connection is closed by the remote side due to a FIN or RST received from the remote side, then the local application MUST be informed whether it closed normally or was aborted (MUST-12).
statements.trigger: FIN or RST received from remote
actions: inform local application whether connection was closed normally (FIN) or aborted (RST)
